intent: A dark, monochrome bar that says who is in the document and what they are doing. Idle people fade. Following someone pins their sentence and moves a ring to their avatar.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with @container queries; colour tokens as CSS variables on the root
stack.animation: motion/react: entrance blur, a rolling count, sentence cross-fades, layoutId for the follow ring, and one ambient pulse on the live dot
stack.fonts: font-sans (Geist) for the sentence, font-display (Geist) for the title and count, font-mono (Geist Mono) for labels

layout.card: surface, 1px line, 14px radius, inset highlight + deep shadow, @container root, 560px max in the demo
layout.header: 18px display title and mono workspace on the left; 20px tabular count and mono HERE on the right
layout.avatars: four 44px buttons, 32px initials, 4px apart. A 6px ink live dot on the first active person. Idle at 50% opacity
layout.sentence: to the right of the avatars from @md, on the next line below that. A long sentence wraps in its column. 15px. Name and place in ink, verb muted. FOLLOWING and STOP appear only while following
layout.empty: one faint line: No one else is in this document

typography.title: display 18px semibold, tracking -0.03em
typography.sentence: 15px, leading 1.4; name medium ink, activity muted

color.approach: greyscale; one accent, and only as the follow ring. The live dot is ink
color.accent: theme ink by default. A 2px ring on the followed avatar

motion.order: card, header, row: 12px rise, 8px blur, 0.5s, 60ms apart
motion.sentence: 4px rise and 3px blur, 0.22s, when the person or the follow state changes
motion.dot: opacity 1 to 0.35 over 2.4s while in view
motion.reducedMotion: 150ms fades, no ring travel, solid dot

responsive.320: avatars stay on one line; the sentence drops below them, full width, with Stop at the end of that line
responsive.390: same stack. Four 44px targets fit; the sentence wraps inside its line rather than truncating a name
responsive.768+: the sentence sits to the right of the avatars inside the 560px card

accessibility: avatar row is a toolbar; each button is aria-pressed and named with the person and their activity
arrow keys move between the buttons
the count is named “4 here”; avatars and the live dot are aria-hidden
a polite live region announces follow, not hover

content.people: Mara Ilić is editing Pricing (live), Priya Raman is commenting in Legal, Sam Okoye is reading the headline, Jonas Weber is idle
content.demo: follows Priya, then follows Jonas, so the ring travels onto the faded avatar and the sentence becomes idle

avoid: multiplayer cursors, carets or selections on a canvas
hiding the activity in a tooltip
idle people drawn at full strength
